title: Forward Deployed Robotics Engineer
description:
Uncharted AI is a deep-tech startup building autonomous robotic systems and AI-powered intelligence platforms for mining, industrial operations, and challenging field environments.

We combine robotics, artificial intelligence, geospatial intelligence, and advanced sensing to transform how industries explore, inspect, and operate in complex environments.

Our technology spans autonomous navigation, robotic sensing, geospatial analysis, and intelligent decision-making. We develop everything from robotic hardware and autonomy software to intelligent platforms that transform complex field data into actionable insights.

We are looking for passionate engineers and technicians who enjoy solving challenging real-world problems, taking ownership, and building technology that operates beyond controlled laboratory environments.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Forward Deployed Robotics Engineer**

to deploy, operate, and maintain autonomous robotic systems at customer sites across India. This is a hands-on engineering role that combines robotics software development, field operations, troubleshooting, and customer-facing deployments.

You will work closely with our robotics engineering team to bring autonomous systems from development environments into reliable, continuous real-world operation.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with robots in challenging industrial environments, debugging problems under operational constraints, and taking responsibility for ensuring successful deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Robotic Deployment & Field Operations**

* Deploy, configure, and commission autonomous robotic systems at customer facilities.
* Supervise autonomous robot operations and ensure reliable execution of assigned missions.
* Monitor robot health, performance, sensor data, and operational status.
* Perform manual or teleoperated intervention whenever autonomous systems require operator assistance.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, networking, and sensor-related issues on-site.
* Conduct preventive maintenance, calibration, and routine inspections.
* Maintain operational logs, incident reports, and deployment documentation.

**Robotics & Autonomy Engineering**

* Configure, test, and optimize autonomous navigation and localization systems.
* Work with SLAM, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and robot control systems.
* Debug robotics software using ROS/ROS 2 and Linux-based development tools.
* Collect, analyze, and report field performance data.
* Collaborate with the core engineering team to improve autonomy reliability.
* Develop scripts and tools that simplify deployment, monitoring, and debugging.

**Customer Engagement**

* Coordinate technical deployment activities with customer teams.
* Support system demonstrations, commissioning, and acceptance testing.
* Communicate technical issues and operational requirements to internal engineering teams.
* Ensure adherence to customer-site safety and operational procedures.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline.
* Hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating robotic systems.
* Working knowledge of ROS/ROS 2.
* Proficiency in Python and/or C++.
* Good understanding of autonomous navigation, robotics sensors, and control systems.
* Experience working with Linux/Ubuntu.
* Ability to troubleshoot electromechanical systems.
* Willingness to travel extensively and work at industrial customer sites across India.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with autonomous mobile robots, quadrupeds, or unmanned ground vehicles.
* Familiarity with LiDAR, cameras, IMUs, GNSS/RTK, and other robotic sensors.
* Experience with SLAM, LiDAR odometry, and localization.
* Understanding of industrial networking, remote monitoring, and telemetry.
* Experience with Docker, Git, SSH, and remote system administration.
* Previous experience deploying robots in mining, manufacturing, or industrial environments.

**Who we're looking for**

Someone who enjoys working directly with robots rather than exclusively behind a desk.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of a deployment, diagnosing problems independently, and working with the engineering team to continuously improve robot reliability.

**The successful candidate will play a critical role in making autonomous robotics dependable in real industrial environments.**

The Incident Response Lead is part of CGI's Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), which provides 24/7 security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response capabilities across the organization.

title: Marketplace Growth Manager (eCommerce Stack
description:
**Job Description**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**What the role owns**

Supply acquisition and seller onboarding - Recruit and onboard independent suppliers and brands onto the seller portal and marketplaces. Convert registered sellers into active and paying sellers, and own the seller experience from sign-up to first sale.

Demand activation - Activate fleet buyers through system integrators and direct channels: campaigns, offers and integrator programmes that turn an order pipeline into orders. Track buyer activation and repeat purchase.

Category expansion - Decide which categories to add and in what order, such as devices, parts and service, FASTag, fuel, insurance and tyres. Build the commercial case and the supply for each, and learn from early cohorts.

Pricing, seller plans and take rate - Own pricing, seller subscription plans and marketplace fees. Balance price competitiveness for buyers with sustainable economics for sellers and for Bosch MPS.

Marketplace health and liquidity - Own the indicators that show whether the marketplace works: price competitiveness, availability, fill rate, delivery performance, returns and disputes, and repeat rate.

Trust and quality - Define seller verification, catalogue quality standards, review and dispute processes, so that buyers trust what they see and sellers are treated fairly.

Fulfilment and service partners - Work with logistics, inventory, workshop and service partners to make delivery and after-sales dependable, and integrate them into the platform.

Embedded finance and payments - Work with the Embedded Financial Services Product Manager to place credit, wallet and payment options at checkout, and define the consented transaction data the marketplace contributes.

Unit economics and business case - Own the marketplace P&L view: contribution per order, acquisition cost and payback, and the breakeven path. Bring clear options to leadership when economics and growth pull in different directions.

Data and experimentation - Define the marketplace metrics, set up the dashboards and run experiments on supply onboarding, search, pricing and promotion.

Partner and platform management - Manage relationships with the host platform and integrator network, and build a playbook that lets the marketplace model be replicated with further platform partners.

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Gross merchandise value and its growth
* Number of active buyers and repeat purchase rate
* Number of active sellers, and conversion of registered sellers into paying sellers
* Number and breadth of listed products, and category coverage
* Fill rate, delivery performance and dispute rate
* Take rate and contribution margin per order
* Share of orders using embedded credit, FASTag or other wallet products
* Buyer and seller acquisition cost and payback

**Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, commerce or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in marketplace, e-commerce, B2B commerce or platform growth, with at least 4 years owning supply, demand or category growth on a two-sided marketplace.
* Has grown both sides of a marketplace, understands liquidity and can show how a marketplace metric moved because of what they did.
* Experience in automotive aftermarket, telematics, logistics or fleet businesses, and familiarity with India's fleet and trucking ecosystem, is a strong advantage.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Two-sided marketplace mechanics: supply onboarding, liquidity, search and ranking, trust and quality, take-rate and subscription models.
* B2B commerce operations: catalogues, pricing, order management, logistics, returns and payments.
* Exposure to embedded finance, lending marketplaces or wallets, and awareness of consent and data protection requirements (DPDP).
* Funnel and cohort analytics, experimentation, and the ability to build a business case from order-level data.
* Working knowledge of channel and integrator-led distribution.

**Commercial skills**

* Commercial negotiation with sellers, brands and channel partners.
* Unit economics, pricing analytics and P&L thinking for a growing marketplace.

**Personal attributes**

* Entrepreneurial and hands-on; comfortable building supply and demand from a modest starting point.
* Relationship builder who earns the trust of sellers, integrators and host platform partners.
* Structured and numerate communicator who brings clear options and evidence to leadership.
* Ownership of outcomes and persistence in a market that is still being built.
* Collaborative across product, engineering, finance, logistics and partner teams.

**Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the eCommerce Stack (MPS/PAS) and the store and marketplace engineering teams
* Product Manager for Embedded Financial Services and the Toll.OS product team (FASTag)
* Logistics stack and marketplace teams
* Finance, Legal and Data Protection
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR) and the Global Partner Manager
* Host platform partners, system integrators, sellers, logistics and service partners

**How to read this role**

This is a growth and product role with business accountability, between a marketplace operator and a product owner. It is not a pure sales role. The ideal candidate has grown a two-sided marketplace and can build the supply, demand and economics at the same time.

**About Zuora**
At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
  
  
We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As our Senior Web Strategy & Experience Specialist, you will be the point of contact for everything web. You will own the website roadmap, decide what gets built and in what order, and make sure the pages our teams need go live quickly and to a high standard. You are obsessed with web experience and data, and you make decisions based on evidence, not opinion or the loudest request. You will give the web development team a clear, prioritized plan to build against.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Website Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the strategic roadmap for the Zuora website. Prioritize by business impact and pipeline contribution rather than reactive requests, and defend the roadmap against ad hoc, out-of-cycle asks.
* Be the single point of contact for all web needs across the company, and run a clear intake, prioritization and launch process that gets pages live predictably for every team.
* Resolve competing priorities at the roadmap level, and communicate trade-offs openly to stakeholders at every level.
* Translate business goals into clear briefs and execution plans for Design and Development.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects (campaign pages, redesigns, migrations, template builds) across Campaigns, Design, Development, Analytics and Product Marketing.

**Performance, Conversion & Experimentation**

* Define the KPIs that matter (conversion rate, engagement, form completion, pipeline contribution) and keep them visible to the business.
* Find friction and opportunity across the user journey, and make sure visitors can find what they need and take the next step.
* Run an ongoing testing and optimization program using A/B tests, behavioral data and session analysis to improve outcomes, not just report on them.
* Improve page speed, accessibility and form experience across key page types.

**Personalization**

* Design and direct the strategy for using behavioral and account-level data (Demandbase, Amplitude and other sources) to serve tailored content and experiences to priority segments.
* Define the audiences, rules, content variants and success metrics, and work with Campaigns and ABM teams to put them into practice.

**Technical SEO & Discoverability**

* Own technical SEO implementation on the site: crawlability, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, redirects, Core Web Vitals and international setup.
* Partner with the SEO & AEO lead so that page templates, components and rendering support both traditional search and AI answer engines.

**Analytics & Data Integrity**

* Work closely with Analytics to make sure tracking, tagging and metrics are accurate and trustworthy across GA4, Amplitude and Looker Studio.
* Build and maintain dashboards that give stakeholders a clear view of site performance, and turn the data into specific recommendations.
* Flag it when a number can’t be trusted, and drive the fix.

**Technical Direction & WordPress Ownership**

* Guide the web development team’s priorities and technical approach on WordPress, including templates, reusable components and governance for how pages are built.
* Make sure the platform stays scalable, performant and easy for non-technical teams to use.

**Global, Security & Brand Standards**

* Set direction for multi-language support, international SEO and region-specific experiences.
* Make sure the website meets required security, privacy and compliance standards, including consent and data handling.
* Partner with Brand and Design so the site reflects Zuora’s positioning and visual identity.

**About You**
**How You’ll Work**

* You start with the business outcome and the user, then work backward to the plan.
* You are comfortable owning the details while keeping the larger roadmap in view.
* You bring structure to ambiguous, competing requests and say no clearly when something doesn’t earn its place.
* You make decisions with data and are honest about what the data does and doesn’t show.
* You collaborate easily with Campaigns, Design, Development, Analytics and Sales, and you earn trust with senior stakeholders.
* You hold a high bar for quality, speed and accessibility.

**Your Experience**

* 6-8 years in a digital or web role, including 3+ years owning a corporate website or digital product, preferably in B2B SaaS.
* Fluency with GA4, Amplitude, Looker Studio and Demandbase.
* Track record of leading a website redesign, platform migration or comparable large-scale initiative end to end.
* Experience setting priorities for and directing web development teams, translating business goals into clear technical plans.

* Experience designing or running personalization based on behavioral and account data.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across Marketing, Product and Sales.
* Strong analytical, communication and prioritization skills.

Our website is often the first real conversation a buyer has with Zuora, and increasingly it is read by AI engines before it is read by people.
